thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 HIGH — SmartRouter anomaly detected at 2026-03-14T14:20Z. Rapid increase in fallback routing decisions: 12% of requests routed to variant 'gpt-mini' (unexpected). Elevated 5xx and latency from eu-west region. Auto-pager to oncall team.
oncall-ajay: acked. I'm on it — pulling logs now.
kevin (sre): I'm seeing a tight loop in the routing decision logs where fallback policy keeps re-evaluating and flipping region preference. Could be policy misconfig + missing route tags.
marina (routing): I noticed a recent policy deploy ~14:10Z that added a fallback chain: primary->region->variant. Maybe the variant match rule is too greedy. Rolling back that policy is probably quickest mitigation.
emily (support): Customer-support: multiple customers in eu-west reporting garbled responses + timeouts. Tickets coming in, estimated impact: ~3% of paying customers for the last 10 min. Marking SEV2.
oncall-ajay: steps: 1) freeze policy rollouts, 2) push manual override to prefer primary region, 3) gather decision logs for the next 15m. Marina can you freeze?
marina (routing): freezing rollout now. also adding a quick override rule to block variant 'gpt-mini' for production traffic. Doing a canary change to the routing config.
ops-bot: change_request: routing.override.block_variant(gpt-mini)=true applied to cluster eu-west by marina at 14:23Z.
kevin (sre): log snippet (from decision log stream):
```
[14:22:45] request_id=abc123 decision=start region=eu-west candidate=primary ok=false reason=kv_cache_miss
[14:22:45] request_id=abc123 decision=fallback region=eu-west candidate=gpt-mini matched_policy=variant_fallback
[14:22:45] request_id=abc123 decision=re-evaluate region=global candidate=primary matched_policy=region_fallback
[14:22:46] request_id=abc123 decision=fallback region=eu-west candidate=gpt-mini matched_policy=variant_fallback
```
kevin (sre): note how route tags are absent in the logs — we can't tell which policy version made the decision. That's an observability gap.
oncall-ajay: marina, after override, can you force traffic to primary region and confirm no more loop?
marina (routing): forcing prefer_primary=true for customers with active sessions in eu-west. Patching in 14:25Z.
ops-bot: routing.prefers_primary=true applied for tenant-scope at 14:25:18Z.
emily (support): update: customers still seeing errors but new errors are fewer. Ticket volume down 40%.
kevin (sre): metrics: 5xx went from 3.2% -> 1.1% in ~6 minutes. Latency tail improved but some sessions still hit gpt-mini.
marina (routing): I can see the override reduced gpt-mini allocations but not eliminated. There's a mismatch in variant tag mapping between the control plane and the runtime — looks like some nodes didn't pick up the override due to stale config cache.
oncall-ajay: plan B: trigger a rolling config refresh on routing proxies in eu-west. Kevin, can you coordinate with eng-infra to do safe restarts?
kevin (sre): on it, calling infra. infra suggests rolling restart with drain; starting at 14:33Z.
ops-bot: infra.restart_start: routing-proxy-eu-west-0 at 14:33Z.
marina (routing): while restarts proceed, adding a temporary rule to drop requests that match the old variant tag mapping to avoid noisy failures. Applying at 14:35Z.
kevin (sre): confirmed restarts completed for 3/4 proxies, final one done 14:38Z. Post-restart checks: config version now matches override across proxies.
emily (support): customer update ready: "We've applied a targeted fix to improve routing stability in EU; we're seeing improvements and will follow up in 2 hours with a full root cause and remediation plan."
oncall-ajay: good. monitoring closely. we should confirm no region-fallback loops remain. Kept tracing hooks enabled for affected request_ids.
kevin (sre): quick check: sampled 200 affected requests from 14:20-14:40Z. 98% now routed to expected primary variant. No further loop patterns observed.
marina (routing): immediate mitigations: 1) rollback greedy fallback rule, 2) block gpt-mini, 3) apply prefer_primary override, 4) rolling config refresh. All done.
emily (support): impact summary for postmortem: customers affected: estimated 3% of paying eu-west tenants, duration ~22 minutes peak, degraded outputs + timeouts. No data loss.
kevin (sre): root cause (preliminary): policy deploy introduced overlapping fallback chains without clear tagging; runtime config cache mismatch caused partial enforcement; observability missing: route decision logs lack policy_version + route_tag fields.
oncall-ajay: handing off to morning oncall and routing owners for postmortem and follow-ups. @marina and @kevin please list action items.
marina (routing): action items I will own: - add policy_version and route_tag to decision logs (slo: 48h) - tighten fallback rule semantics + unit tests (slo: 72h) - add a deploy-time validation to block overlapping fallback chains (slo: 96h).
kevin (sre): action items I will own: - ensure config cache invalidation works and add alert if nodes diverge (slo: 48h) - add a tracing enrichment that ties request_id -> routing_policy_version (slo: 72h) - coordinate a tabletop next week.
emily (support): support action items: - send customer follow-up emails, include mitigation timeline and ETA for RCA (slo: 6h) - collate all customer ticket IDs for EM escalation.
oncall-ajay: logging a dedicated postmortem. I'll include timeline and paste these notes. Good job on rapid coordination. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident-resolved: SmartRouter routing loop mitigated and override removed at 14:50Z; monitoring in watch for 2 hours.
kevin (sre): quick note for postmortem: include the exact policy diff and the runtime config versions. Need to capture the failed deploy id.
marina (routing): I'll attach the rollout diff and router config snapshots to the postmortem doc.
emily (support): closing live customer comms for now; will reopen if regressions.
noncall-ajay: last check: error rate back to baseline 0.3% for eu-west. closing the incident in 30m if stable.
kevin (sre): added temporary dashboard tile for routing decision distribution by variant + policy_version (when available).
marina (routing): long-term: propose we add an automated canary that validates policy decisions against simulation before rollout.
emily (support): thanks team — recording this thread into the incident ticket.
incident-bot: note: follow-up tasks created: PM-1123 (RCA), SRE-442 (config cache alert), ROUTE-87 (add route_tag logs).
